title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E1 — Lucille Ball, Ed Sullivan, Osmond Brothers
Lucy & Flips are two halves of a horse; the whole cast portrays Peanuts characters; Geraldine & Lucy are car hops at the drive-in.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E2 — Joan Rivers, George Gobel
Flip does the shell game; Joan does stand-up and plays a cabdriver; Freddie Johnson buys jewelry from Gobel & Rivers.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E5 — George Carlin, Pat Boone & Family, Sugar Ray Robinson
Flip sells ice cream; Flip & Carlin do a TV news spoof; Boone intros his family and the cast does a "To Tell A Lie" panel show sketch.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E3 — Frederick Douglass
This program traces the roots of Black protest in America by means of passages from Frederick Douglass' greatest orations, dramatized by Arthur Bufghardt, interspersed with performances by drummer Max Roach.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E6 — Bill Withers/Mae Jackson
Featured guest Bill Withers sings hit single, "Ain't No Sunshine" and other selections from his album, Just As I Am.  In another segment, young poetess Mae Jackson reads from her own works.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E14 — Ticket to Ride
Webster gets a brand new bike, but ends up getting a ticket from a cop.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E15 — The Science Project
When Frieda gets sick and can't make it to the science fair, Webster has to come to the rescue.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E16 — The Gospel Truth
Webster inadvertently books a gospel group instead of a rock band for a school party.

title: Webster
description:
S6 E17 — The Visitor
Webster's pen pal is an adult butler from England, and he visits to meet Webster in person before he dies.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

While taking a bus to the movies, Tia and Tamera fight over the disadvantages of being a twin, but when they get lost, they must team up to find their way home.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

When a pimple pops up just before Tia's big date, Tamera agrees to step in for her -- and finds herself falling for Tia's guy.

description:

Tamera scratches the fender of her father's prized car, then tries to hide the truth with the help of Tia and Roger.

title: Sister, Sister
description:

The twins' first birthday together leaves Tamera's best friend feeling left out, and Ray locked in an argument with Lisa over his parenting methods.

description:

Moesha houses a beautiful French exchange student.  Q picks the French girl and Kim to be back-up singers in his new band.

description:

Moesha wants to throw Hakeem a surprise birthday party and invites his estranged father.

description:

Niecy meets a wonderful recent graduate now in the military.  When he asks her to marry him, she says yes!

title: Moesha
description:

Mo invites Q over when she thinks the whole family is away for the day.  However, they return home early and Mo and Q are caught.

S2 E2 — Fourth Time Around
Mary and Rose help Pearl face the loneliness of old age by escorting her to a single's bar where she meets the man of her dreams--and promptly gets engaged.

S2 E3 — Pillow Talk
When Mary reluctantly agrees to partner with Sandra in the pillow-making business, she finds herself doing all the work--with Sandra reaping all the 'benefits.'.

S2 E4 — Mary Nightingale
Lester turns into a real pain for Mary when he comes home from work early complaining of a stomach ache, but when she sneaks out for a pedicure, Lester is stricken with appendicitis--leaving Sandra to care for him.

S2 E5 — The Great Man Hunt
Alarmed that her biological clock is winding down, Sandra sets out to find a perfect husband to father her child, but when she strikes out with the available men, she decides to have a baby anyway--regardless of her marital status.
